title: The quotient-system dual of compact support
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from D.p, a finite extension E of Q_l and a separated finite-type scheme X over D.k, with the coefficient sequence categories of def-coef-ringed-sequence-site. For any derived coefficient calculus S and any actual compactification pairing frame G of lem-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing, define integralDualizingSystemSupport to be the inclusion of integral constructible objects followed by S.reduction, G.openModules.mapDerivedCategory and G.properModules.rightDerivedFunctor. Define integralDualizingSupportSystemHom to be the opposite of this functor followed by quotient-sequence internal Hom into the tensor unit of G.baseTensors.systemClosed and then coefPairingSections at Spec D.k. Both are literal functor composites before any inverse limit; the existing tensor unit is reused.

proof.text: Compose the stated actual derived reduction, open extension and proper image functors. No witness is chosen from an existence theorem and no inverse limit or exceptional adjunction is used.
